about_overview_desc: SmartApply is an automated document verification and mismatch detection system. Its main purpose is to help users detect data discrepancies across their supporting documents (like Name or Date of Birth on Aadhaar vs. PAN) before they submit official applications, preventing unnecessary rejections and delays.
about_how_1: Users select a government service to see the required document checklist.
about_how_2: Users upload images of their documents.
about_how_3: The system extracts key details using Optical Character Recognition (OCR).
about_how_4: A built-in rule engine cross-checks the data across all documents.
about_how_5: If a mismatch is found, actionable correction guidance is provided.
services_desc: Explore our automated verification tools, OCR extraction capabilities, and dynamic document checklists.

hero_sub: Where Your Government Forms Get Simple
tagline: Your guide to government forms and ID corrections
upload_instruction: Upload each required document — we'll automatically scan it for the name, date of birth, and address, then check for mismatches in the next step.
ocr_disclaimer: This tool performs text matching only. It does not verify that documents are genuine, authentic, or legally valid. This is not official government verification.

about_new_heading: Making applications simpler, one document at a time.
about_new_description: Sahayak is an independent platform that helps you prepare documents for government and academic applications. Find the right checklist, review possible information mismatches, and get guidance before visiting the official application portal.
about_new_features_heading: What can you do with Sahayak?
about_new_features_subtitle: Simple guidance to help you prepare before applying.
about_new_feature1_desc: Choose a service and find the application you want to prepare for.
about_new_feature2_desc: View the document checklist for your selected service and identify missing documents.
about_new_feature3_desc: Upload supported documents and check for possible differences in names, dates of birth, and addresses.
about_new_feature4_desc: Find correction guidance and continue to the relevant official portal when you are ready.
about_new_disclaimer: Sahayak is an independent helper, not an official government website. Document checks are automated consistency checks, not official identity verification or a guarantee of application approval.
login_modal_intro: Sign in to upload, review and check your documents.
login_modal_privacy_desc: Documents may contain sensitive personal information. Sahayak processes uploaded files to extract details and identify possible differences between documents.
login_modal_privacy_tip: Only upload documents you own or have permission to use. Review your files before uploading.
login_modal_disclaimer: Independent helper. Not an official government website.
doc_inline_unavailable: Preview unavailable. Please use the View button.
mf_section_intro: Sahayak compares extracted data. You decide whether a difference is real and which document needs correction.
mf_compare_notice: Compare the original documents. OCR can misread text, and a difference does not prove which document is wrong.
mf_confirm_question: Is this a real difference in the original documents?
mf_which_hint: Use reliable supporting evidence before choosing. Sahayak does not assume one document is always correct.
mf_confirmed_note: Only the document you selected is shown below. Complete the official correction, upload the updated file, then recheck.
mf_step1: Check the correct details against authoritative supporting records.
mf_step2_form: Locate this correction form or service
mf_step2_generic: Find the correction process on the issuing authority’s official website or contact its service centre.
mf_step3: Prepare the required identity, date-of-birth, or address proof listed by the issuing authority.
mf_step4: Submit through the official process, retain the acknowledgement, and upload the corrected document here once available.
mf_generic_notice: No document-specific verified steps are available here. Check the issuing authority before submitting.
mf_fees_notice: Forms, fees, supporting documents and processing times can change. Confirm the latest rules on the official portal.
mf_ocr_status: OCR extraction may be wrong. Review and edit the extracted fields, or rescan the document.
mf_choose_again: Choose an incorrect document to get guidance.
md_subtitle: Choose the missing requirement and find where to obtain an accepted document.
md_exemption: This is an exemption, not a document. Use it only when eligible.
md_internal: This document has a service in Sahayak. Open its checklist to prepare it.
md_regional: Maharashtra source only. For another state, check that state's issuing department.
md_issuer: Check the issuing authority and whether the record is available online.
md_local: Contact the relevant bank, school, provider or other issuing organization. There may be no single government website for this document.
md_directory: Find the issuing authority through the official government service directory. This directory is not itself a document issuing portal.
md_step1: Confirm which document will be accepted.
md_step2: Obtain it from the relevant issuing authority.
md_step3: Return to this checklist and upload the document.
md_disclaimer: Sahayak does not issue documents. Check the latest rules on the official site.
